key_agent_trends: Major labs acquire specialized coding-agent infrastructure to control the full development stack
Frontier models add native computer-use and vision for long-horizon agent workflows
Domain-specific agent skills accelerate scientific research cycles from days to hours
Enterprise marketplaces expand partner agents with committed-spend purchasing
Parallel multi-agent orchestration becomes a key acquisition target for coding platforms

stories.headline: Meta acquires Conductor, startup for running parallel teams of coding agents
stories.what_happened: On November 4, 2026, Meta acquired Conductor, a Y Combinator-backed startup whose Mac app and cloud service enable developers to run multiple coding agents (including Claude Code, Codex and Cursor) in isolated parallel workspaces. Conductor Cloud will shut down on November 20; the local app continues with updates until early 2027. Founders join Meta Superintelligence Labs under Nat Friedman and Alexandr Wang. Terms were not disclosed.
stories.why_it_matters: Strengthens Meta's position in agentic coding tools by acquiring multi-agent orchestration expertise, as major labs race to own the developer interfaces around their models.

stories.headline: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer to expand Codex with agent-oriented code storage
stories.what_happened: On November 4, 2026, OpenAI announced it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, the maker of Code Storage (a distributed Git-based store designed for machine workloads) and open-source tools including Trees and Diffs already used in Codex. The deal aims to adapt Git workflows for parallel agent coding. Open-source projects remain open; Code Storage customers continue while features integrate into Codex. Closing subject to regulatory approvals; terms undisclosed.
stories.why_it_matters: Positions Codex as a fuller platform for agent-driven software development, reducing reliance on external repos as coding agents generate more parallel changes.

stories.headline: Tencent releases Hy4 with vision and computer-use for long-horizon agents
stories.what_happened: On November 4, 2026, Tencent released Hy4, its latest model with a 1M-token context. It adds vision understanding and computer-use capabilities (CLI and GUI, with specialized training on tools like Blender and CAD) for the first time, plus major gains in long-horizon tasks and reduced hallucination. Available on Tencent Cloud, OpenRouter and Tencent products; weights planned for later open-source release.
stories.why_it_matters: Expands competitive open-model options for agentic workflows that combine perception, tool use and multi-step productivity, particularly for document, coding and scientific tasks.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind adds Cheminformatics Skills to Antigravity for agentic drug discovery
stories.what_happened: On November 3, 2026, Google DeepMind released Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity. Agents use RDKit, ChEMBL and PubChem connectors to search compounds, run matched molecular pair analysis and propose new molecules with synthesis routes. A lung-cancer TKI example compressed a multi-day workflow to about an hour. Skills available via the Science plugin; 10,000 scientists offered free highest-tier access for six months.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows domain-specific agent skills can accelerate scientific iteration by combining LLM orchestration with deterministic chemistry tools, reducing error-prone data work in drug design.

stories.headline: Anthropic expands Claude Marketplace with over 25 partner agents and products
stories.what_happened: On November 4, 2026, Anthropic added new partner agents and products to Claude Marketplace covering security, developer infrastructure, creative and productivity tools. Eligible enterprises can apply committed Anthropic spend toward these solutions. The marketplace now lists more than 25 partner agents and products.
stories.why_it_matters: Lowers procurement friction for enterprise Claude deployments by bundling partner agents under existing spend commitments, accelerating governed agent adoption.
